entries.name: game_hud_stats
entries.title: Stats
entries.description: Exp/h, raw exp/h, DPS, HPS, MPS, damage received, kills, graphs in a mini-window.

entries.name: game_autoloot
entries.title: Autoloot
entries.description: Named loot backpacks with item search; Apply sends !autoloot clear/add.

entries.name: game_loot_tracker
entries.title: Autoloot tracker
entries.description: Mini-window listing the items the server loots for you with carried counts.

entries.name: game_player_info
entries.title: Player info
entries.description: Other players shown as [RP 250] Name (vocation and level from an automatic look).

entries.name: game_exiva
entries.title: Exiva
entries.description: Exiva replies drawn on the minimap (ring sectors, intersections, explored-tile mask) plus the name floating at the edge of the game view in the target's direction.

entries.name: game_pos_hud
entries.title: Position HUD
entries.description: Your x, y, z in one line at the top-right corner of the minimap.

entries.name: game_better_chat
entries.title: Better chat
entries.description: Split view beside the console with coloured [!] filter tabs: sources, channels, include/exclude patterns, flash, sound; keeps your channels open.

entries.name: game_module_installer
entries.title: Module installer
entries.description: This installer: lists the published modules, installs, updates and removes them without a client restart.
